questions.question:
Find the measure of angle ABC (in degrees) in the parallelogram ABCD as shown in the given figure:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b53e3f7d421322ecd0c654a2f92568bd81b36355c3927531ebde0d94dcbecf94.png]

[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0612e08ee4d5cafe90a6e2c44dd8ccd016f1a6351d21a7559efd1527eb3c48f9.png] 

Given, ∠PAB = 9x + 5 and ∠BCD = 16X

∠BCD = RBA = 16x [Pairs of corresponding angles]

As we know,

∠PAB + ∠RBA = 180° [Pair of interior angles on the same side of a transverse line]

9x + 5 + 16x = 180°

25x + 5 = 180

25x = 180 – 5 = 175°

x = 175/25 = 7

∠RBA = 16x = 16 × 7 = 112°

∠RBA + ∠ABC = 180 [Straight line]

∠ABC = 180 – 112 = 68°

questions.question: If the edge of a cube is halved, then its volume reduces to _______ times its original volume.
questions.solution:
Let the edge of the cube be 'a'

As we know,

The volume of the cube = a³

If each edge of the cube is halved, then edge of the cube = a/2

Then, the volume of the new cube = (a/2)³ = a³/8

∴ The proportion to which the new volume reduces to the original volume is = a3/8 ÷ a³ = 1/8.

Thus, the correct answer is option **3.**

questions.question: The age of a mother 10 years ago was thrice the age of her son. 10 years hence, the mother’s age will be twice that of her son. The ratio of their present ages is:
questions.solution:
let age of her son 10 years ago was be x

So, age of mother 10 years ago = 3x

According to the question

(3x + 20)/(x + 20) = 2/1

3x + 20 = 2x + 40

3x - 2x = 40 - 20

x = 20

Age of her son 10 years ago was x = 20 years

Present age of her son = 20 + 10 = 30

Age of mother 10 years ago was = 3x = 3 × 20 = 60 years

Present age of mother = 60 + 10 = 70 years

Ratio of ages of mother to her son = 70 : 30 = 7 : 3

Hence, 7 : 3 is the correct answer.

M₁ × D₁ = M₂ × D₂

∴ 10 more men required to finish the painting work in 4 days.

questions.question: A sum of Rs 110 is in the form of Rs. 2, Rs. 1, and 50 paise coins in the ration of 1 : 2 : 3 respectively, how many 50 paise coins are there?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Total sum = Rs. 110

Ratio of coins of Rs. 2, Rs. 1 and 50 paise = 1 : 2 : 3

**Calculation:**

Ratio of rupees of Rs. 2, Rs. 1 and 50 paise = (2 × 1) : (1 × 2) : (3/2) = 4 : 4 : 3

Let the ratio of rupees of Rs. 2, Rs. 1 and 50 paise be 4x : 4x : 3x

According to the question

(4x + 4x + 3x) = 110

x = 10

Total rupees of 50 paise = 3x = 3 × 10 = Rs. 30

Total coins of 50 paise = 30 × 2 = 60

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3174dfa4d348bfb5b100a3f94b657b6b2048a067fc1bbdb4980dead8ec62eb8f.png] 

Given:

Ratio of coins is 1 : 2 : 3,

Denomination of Rs. 2, Rs. 1, and Rs. 0.50 respectively.

Now according to the question,

⇒ 150x + 200x + 200x = 11,000

⇒ 550x = 11,000

⇒ x = 11,000/550

⇒ x = 20

Rs. 0.50 coins are = 3 × 20 = 60

questions.question: What is the HCF of 16, 72 and 28?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

HCF must be a factor of the smallest difference between any two numbers.

Differences: 28 − 16 = 12, 72 − 28 = 44, 72 − 16 = 56.

Factors of the smallest difference (12) are: 1, 2, 3, 4, 6, 12.

The highest factor among these that divides 16, 72, and 28 is 4.

**∴ The correct answer is 4.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

Given numbers: 16, 72, 28

Formula Used: Prime Factorization Method

⇒ 16 = 2 × 2 × 2 × 2 = 2⁴

⇒ 72 = 2 × 2 × 2 × 3 × 3 = 2³ × 3²

⇒ 28 = 2 × 2 × 7 = 2² × 7

⇒ HCF = Product of common prime factors with the lowest power

⇒ HCF = 2² = 4

**∴ The correct answer is 4.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Highest Common Factor (HCF)

HCF is the greatest number that divides two or more numbers without leaving any remainder.

Least Common Multiple (LCM)

LCM is the smallest number that is exactly divisible by each of the given numbers.

HCF and LCM Relation

For any two numbers a and b, Product of numbers = HCF(a,b) × LCM(a,b).</p

questions.question: 1200 soldiers in a fort had enough food for 28 days. After 4 days, some soldiers left the fort. Thus, food lasted for 32 days, how many soldiers left the fort?
questions.solution:
Let the number of soldiers who left the fort be x.

As we know,

M₁ × D₁ = M₂ × D₂ + M₃ × D₃

Given, M₁ = 1200 soldiers, D₁ = 28 days, M₂ = 1200 soldiers, D₂ = 4 days, M₃ = (1
200 – x) soldiers and D₃ = 32

M₁ × D₁ = M₂ × D₂ + M₃ × D₃

1200 × 28 = 1200 × 4 + (1200 – x) × 32

(1200 × 28) – (1200 × 4) = (1200 – x) × 32

1200 (28 – 4) = (1200 – x) × 32

(1200 × 24)/32 = (1200 – x)

x = 30
